name: product_holder
title: Product holder
summary: Open top cradle for a real product in the catalog (a streaming box, a phone standing upright, a power bank), built from the maker's published sizes: it wraps the bottom and sides, keeps the screen and unlocated ports clear, raises the product over a cable slot when it has a port underneath, and on a wall screws on with two countersunk screws, sized for the load.

params.name: product
params.help: the exact product, from the catalog (stone show reads it from the request)

params.name: mount
params.help: desk = stands on a desk or shelf; wall = screws to a wall

params.name: clearance
params.help: room per side between the product and the holder

params.name: load
params.help: the force the wall holder is designed to carry, in newtons

params.name: screw
params.help: wall screw size, M (4 = M4), countersunk
